queries.name: person
queries.query: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE toLower(p.name) = toLower($name) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:member_of]->(t:Team) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:owns]->(s:System) OPTIONAL MATCH (d:Decision)-[:decided_by]->(p) RETURN properties(p), collect(DISTINCT t.name), collect(DISTINCT s.name), count(DISTINCT d)

queries.name: person_decisions
queries.query: MATCH (d:Decision)-[:decided_by]->(p:Person) WHERE toLower(p.name) = toLower($name) OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:decided_by]->(co:Person) WITH d, collect(DISTINCT co.name) AS deciders OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:about_system]->(s:System) RETURN d.id, d.title, d.decided_on, deciders, collect(DISTINCT s.name) ORDER BY d.decided_on

queries.name: person_activity
queries.query: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE toLower(p.name) = toLower($name) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:leads]->(lt:Team) WITH p, collect(DISTINCT lt.name) AS teams_led OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:leads]->(lp:Project) WITH p, teams_led, collect(DISTINCT lp.name) AS projects_led OPTIONAL MATCH (raised:Ticket)-[:raised_by]->(p) WITH p, teams_led, projects_led, count(DISTINCT raised) AS raised OPTIONAL MATCH (assigned:Ticket)-[:assigned_to]->(p) WITH p, teams_led, projects_led, raised, count(DISTINCT assigned) AS assigned OPTIONAL MATCH (m:Meeting)-[:attended_by]->(p) RETURN teams_led, projects_led, raised, assigned, count(DISTINCT m)
